# Mr. L Production — full site reference

> A creative studio turning bold ideas into powerful digital experiences — branding, web design and motion graphics. Based in Mumbai, India. Tagline: "Make Ideas Move."

## About

Mr. L Production is a small creative studio. We craft visuals, build brands, and create digital experiences that inspire, engage, and make an impact. Stats shown on the site: 50+ projects completed, 30+ happy clients, 100% creative focus.

## Services

### Branding & Identity — starting from ₹50,000
From the first sketch to a full identity system — logo, colour, type and voice. Deliverables: logo & wordmark, colour & type system, brand guidelines, stationery & social kit.
https://mr-l-production.pages.dev/services/branding-identity

### Web Design & Development — starting from ₹80,000
Fast, accessible, mobile-first websites built on modern stacks. Deliverables: UX & UI design, Next.js development, CMS & e-commerce, SEO & performance.
https://mr-l-production.pages.dev/services/web-design-development

### Motion Graphics & Video — starting from ₹60,000
Cinematic reels, product films and animated stories. Deliverables: brand films & reels, product videos, 2D / 3D animation, social cut-downs.
https://mr-l-production.pages.dev/services/motion-graphics-video

### Ways to work with us
- Project — best for: a launch, a rebrand or a single campaign.
- Retainer — best for: brands shipping new work every month.
- Dedicated — best for: a big launch or a multi-month programme.

## Process (6 weeks, then support)

1. Week 1 — Discover: understand the vision, audience, competitors and constraints.
2. Week 2 — Define & Concept: shape the idea into concepts with a clear direction.
3. Weeks 3–4 — Create: concepts, prototypes and films, shown early and often.
4. Week 5 — Refine: structured critique rounds and revisions.
5. Week 6 — Deliver & Launch: files, guidelines, training and launch.
6. Week 7+ — Support: a month of support while the work meets the real world.

Full timeline: https://mr-l-production.pages.dev/process

## FAQ (summary)

- How much does a project cost? Focused engagements typically start at ₹50,000. After a short Discover call the studio gives a fixed quote — no hourly surprises.
- How long does a project take? A focused branding, web or motion project usually takes 3–6 weeks. Larger projects are scoped in phases with dates agreed up front.
- Who will I work with? Directly with the senior people making the work — no hand-offs to juniors, no chain of account managers.
- Do you work with startups? Yes — roughly half the work is with early-stage teams.
- How many revision rounds are included? Two structured revision rounds per phase, with a review call each time. Extra rounds are quoted in advance.
- Who owns the work when we are done? The client does. On final payment, all finished files, source assets and guidelines are theirs.
- Do you work remotely? Yes. Most projects run fully remote, with video workshops for Discover and reviews.
- What do you need from us to start? One honest conversation and whatever already exists — a brief, a deck, a rough budget and a deadline.

Full FAQ: https://mr-l-production.pages.dev/faq
